key_insight: Detonation-spraying parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based coatings.
engineering_relevance: Selecting nozzle traverse speed and spray distance offers a route to controlling coating geometry and maximizing water repellency.
method: Evaluate coating surface properties under varied detonation-spraying conditions.
Relate roughness and thickness to nozzle traverse speed using inverse power laws.
Model roughness and contact angle versus spray distance using parabolic relationships.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports parameter–property relationships and optimal conditions for maximum hydrophobicity, but provides no numerical results or validation metrics.
watch_item: The predictive equations should be validated within the intended equipment, material, and operating ranges before process transfer.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
